name: Clonable
summary: Creates a continuously-translated clone of your existing website — fast multilingual versions that stay synced as your site changes, without rebuilding it.
best_for: businesses that want a fast, continuously-updated translated version of an existing website without rebuilding it as a multilingual site
skip_if: you need human-quality translation for legal, medical or brand-critical copy, or you only need a one-off translation rather than an ongoing synced clone
honest_knock: It's a continuous subscription, not a one-time translation: you pay every month to keep the translated clone synced with your site. It's also machine translation under the hood, so quality varies by language pair; have a native speaker spot-check high-stakes pages. Worth knowing before you compare tiers: the pricing page opens on its annual setting, so the figure you see first is not what a monthly subscription costs.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (prices re-verified 2026-09-21 on clonable.net/pricing; the page blocks plain fetches and was read in a browser) Two ladders behind a Website / Online Store tab, each with a Per month / Annually switch that opens on Annually. Website plans, annual setting: Free €0 for 1 clone and up to 20 translated pages (an upgrade to 50 pages is €25 a month), Business €49 for 3 clones and 400 pages, Pro €79 for 5 clones and 1,200 pages, Expert €249 for 10 clones and 5,000 pages, Premium €999 for 20 clones and 50,000 pages. Click Per month and the same five read €0, €59, €95, €299 and €1,199. Online Store plans, annual setting: Ecommerce Small €99 for 1 clone and 1,000 translated pages, Medium €299 for 5,000 pages, Large €499 for 15,000 pages, each with an XML product feed billed separately at €30, €50 and €75 a month per feed, and a non-translation clone from €49, €149 or €249. An additional clone with its pages is €25 a month on Business and Pro and €50 on Expert and Premium. Optional setup assistance is €250 on the website plans (€1,000 on Premium) and €250 on Ecommerce Small against €950 on Medium and Large. The comparison table below the cards used to contradict the Expert card on the clone count; Clonable corrected it after we reported the mismatch, and on 21 September 2026 its 'Max. number of clones' row reads 1, 3, 5, 10, 20 across Free, Business, Pro, Expert and Premium, matching the cards, as do the installation-assistance and additional-clone rows.

compare_with.name: Weglot
compare_with.why: Weglot is the established website-translation layer with published pricing; Clonable positions as a full continuously-synced clone — both are subscription localization, and both need a human spot-check on quality
